title: 光阻烘烤與顯影控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解軟烤、酸擴散、溶解與輪廓，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 烘烤機制
stages.description: 在「烘烤機制」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for bake mechanisms, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 軟烤與 PEB
steps.objective: 完成「軟烤與 PEB」的因果圖，把軟烤、酸擴散、溶解與輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate softbake and peb, connecting relevant limits in softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：軟烤與 PEB。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate softbake and PEB. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「軟烤與 PEB」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate softbake and peb and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「軟烤與 PEB」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate softbake and peb: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 軟烤與 PEB的原理
knowledge.text: 除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。
knowledge.textEn: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 軟烤調整溶劑與薄膜狀態，PEB 驅動曝光後反應；兩者的合格結果應以各自的物理目的定義。
knowledge.textEn: Softbake adjusts solvent and film state while PEB drives post-exposure reaction; accept each against its own physical purpose.

quiz.question: 評估「軟烤與 PEB」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate softbake and peb?
options: 除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。
相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。
軟烤與 PEB 可視為相同化學步驟。
optionsEn: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions.
Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps.
Softbake and PEB are the same chemical step.
quiz.explanation: 除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。 軟烤調整溶劑與薄膜狀態，PEB 驅動曝光後反應；兩者的合格結果應以各自的物理目的定義。
quiz.explanationEn: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions. Softbake adjusts solvent and film state while PEB drives post-exposure reaction; accept each against its own physical purpose.

steps.title: 熱板與片溫

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for separate hotplate and wafer temperature, connecting relevant limits in softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：熱板與片溫。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：設定溫度不能等同於光阻瞬間溫度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate hotplate and wafer temperature. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Setpoint does not equal instantaneous resist temperature. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「設定溫度不能等同於光阻瞬間溫度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Setpoint does not equal instantaneous resist temperature. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「熱板與片溫」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate hotplate and wafer temperature and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「熱板與片溫」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for separate hotplate and wafer temperature: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess residual solvent. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Residual solvent affects development and mechanical behavior. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「溶劑殘留會影響顯影與材料力學行為。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for assess residual solvent: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for assess thermal contact, connecting relevant limits in softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：接觸熱阻。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：晶圓翹曲與背面污染會改變熱接觸。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess thermal contact. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Wafer bow and backside contamination alter thermal contact. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「晶圓翹曲與背面污染會改變熱接觸。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Wafer bow and backside contamination alter thermal contact. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「接觸熱阻」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

steps.check: 交付「接觸熱阻」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for assess thermal contact: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：升溫與冷卻。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：化學反應不一定只發生在名義保溫時間內。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Include heating and cooling. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Chemical reaction need not occur only during nominal dwell. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「化學反應不一定只發生在名義保溫時間內。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
